## About
Accidents happen. When they do, we're here on Sepulveda Blvd in Van Nuys to fix the damage and make the whole process easier on you. We handle the body work, the frame, the paint and the paperwork, and we work on all makes and models.
Our paint technicians work in a clean paint booth and use computerized paint mixing so the color matches the rest of your car. Beyond collision work, we do custom matte paint, classic car restoration, windshield repair and wheel and rim repair.
One reviewer put it simply: ask to speak with the shop's owner, Jason. He'll answer your questions, keep you posted, and help you set up a rental and coordinate your insurance claim.

## Services
- Collision and auto body service: Personal service from people who know auto body and collision work.
- Dent and scratch repair: Small dings and scratches on bumpers, doors, fenders, hoods, roofs and quarter panels.
- Frame work: From a simple dent to more complex frame repair.
- Auto paint: Complete paint jobs or spot work, matched with computerized paint mixing and done in a clean paint booth.
- Custom matte paint: Matte paint for your car, including help designing a custom color.
- Classic car restoration: Bringing a classic back to its original condition and back on the road.
- Windshield repair: We fix, repair or replace cracked and broken windshields.
- Wheel and rim repair: Bent wheels from rough LA streets. Stop by and have our technician take a look.
- Free towing following an accident: We tow your car to our facility immediately following an accident.

## FAQ
Q: Can you help with my insurance claim?
A: Yes. We help from the very beginning, answer your questions, and coordinate your insurance claim.

Q: What do I do for a car while mine is being repaired?
A: If you have no other way to get around after the accident, we'll help you arrange a rental car. Pickup from our shop is available.

Q: How do I get home after you tow my car?
A: After the tow, we give you a courtesy ride back to your home or office. Just call and we'll coordinate it.

Q: What are your hours on Sunday?
A: We're open Sunday from 7:00 AM to 7:30 PM.

Q: How do I set up an estimate?
A: Call us at 818-997-2626, or send your name, contact information and a requested time through the contact form.
